2. Craft 4 dark oak planks using 1 dark oak logs.
3. Craft 1 dark oak button using 1 dark oak plank.

- Obtain 1 dark oak log
- Use the dark oak log to craft 4 dark oak planks
- Use 1 of those dark oak planks to craft 1 dark oak button
